Tencent footnote (d): 2018-early2024 = 'additions (excluding business combinations) to property, plant and equipment, construction in progress, investment properties, land use rights and intangible assets (excluding media/video/music contents, game licences and other content)'; from FY2024 report onward = 'investments in IT infrastructure (computer equipment, components, software), data centres, land use rights, office premises and intellectual properties (excluding media content)'. Series is continuous across the wording change: every annual sum reconciles to Tencent-reported FY totals (FY2018=23941, FY2021=33392, FY2022=18014, FY2023=23893, FY2024=76760, FY2025=79198).
0700.HK.fcf_def: Tencent-reported non-IFRS Free Cash Flow. New definition (2020 onward, used for 2019 restated & 2020-2026): net cash generated from operating activities minus payments for capital expenditure, media content payments, and lease-liability payments. 2018 values use Tencent's OLD definition (operating cash flow minus capex only); Tencent never published restated 2018 figures, so 2018 is not strictly comparable to 2019+. 2019 values are Tencent's OFFICIALLY RESTATED new-definition figures (1Q=16.8, 2Q=12.6, 3Q=28.1, 4Q=31.3 bn). 2024-Q4 (~4500) and 2025-Q4 (~34000) are DERIVED = reported full-year FCF (155.3 / 182.6 bn) minus reported 9-month FCF; all other quarters are directly Tencent-reported. Annual reconciliations hold: FY2023 = 167.0bn, FY2024 = 155.3bn, FY2025 = 182.6bn.

9988.HK.name: 알리바바
9988.HK.capex_def: "Capital expenditures" as stated in Alibaba's results-announcement cash-flow narrative (e.g. '...capital expenditures of RMB26,887 million (US$3,898 million)' for the quarter ended March 31, 2026). Represents purchase of property and equipment and intangible assets per the consolidated cash flow statement, and explicitly 'included cash outflow for acquisition of land use rights and construction in progress relating to office campuses'. NOTE: this is Alibaba's headline capex figure and is LARGER than the 'Less: Purchase of property and equipment' line in the Free-cash-flow reconciliation table (which excludes office-campus land use rights/CIP; e.g. 26,588 vs 26,887 for Mar-2026 quarter). Quarterly capex first cleanly disclosed for the quarter ended Sep 30, 2018 (2018-Q3); for 2018-Q1/Q2 only a combined 'capital expenditures and acquisition of intangible assets [and licensed copyrights]' figure was given, so those two quarters are omitted from capex.
9988.HK.fcf_def: Free cash flow represents net cash provided by operating activities as presented in our consolidated cash flow statement less purchases of property and equipment (excluding acquisition of land use rights and construction in progress relating to office campuses) and intangible assets (excluding those acquired through acquisitions), as well as adjustments to exclude from net cash provided by operating activities the buyer protection fund deposits from merchants on our marketplaces. (non-GAAP measurement of liquidity; verbatim from Alibaba results announcement, quarter ended Mar 31 2026)

NBIS.name: Nebius
NBIS.capex_def: Purchases of property and equipment and intangible assets, from the U.S. GAAP condensed consolidated statement of cash flows (investing activities), CONTINUING operations; Nebius labels this 'capital expenditures'. guidance.text: FY2026 capex guidance: USD 20-25 billion (current; reaffirmed at Q2 2026). RAISED at the Q1 2026 earnings call (2026-05-13) from a prior USD 16-20 billion range. Q2 2026 shareholder letter (2026-08-12): "We are reaffirming our full-year 2026 guidance across all metrics"; company expects >USD 9 billion of customer prepayments in 2026 covering 50-60% of capex. Nebius states detailed numeric guidance is given on the earnings call/webcast, not in the written press release. Earlier: FY2025 capex plan was raised to ~USD 2 billion at Q1 2025 (from ~USD 1.5 billion); actual FY2025 capex came in at USD 4,066 million. 0700.HK.name: Tencent

calls.note: June-2026 quarter call DID happen — today, 2026-08-12. Only a Chinese-language transcript of the (English) call was retrievable; English transcript not yet published anywhere reachable.

quotes.speaker: Tencent 2Q2026 results release (management commentary)
quotes.en: We recorded negative free cash flow of RMB13.8 billion for 2Q2026, as net cash generated from operating activities of RMB52.7 billion was more than offset by capital expenditure payments of RMB59.3 billion, media content payments of RMB5.0 billion and lease liability payments of RMB2.2 billion. Included in our operating cash flow were large AI-related prepayments to provide infrastructure to support our Hy model enhancements, WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy inference needs, Weixin AI initiatives, and development of AI capabilities across our products and services, as well as to meet growing external demand for our cloud services. Excluding the prepayments for compute procurement, our free cash flow would have been RMB37.6 billion.
quotes.ko: FCF -138억위안 전환을 '算力 선불금' 탓으로 돌리며, 선불금 제외 시 +376억위안이라는 조정치를 스스로 제시.

quotes.speaker: Robin Zhu, Bernstein
quotes.en: 本季度资本开支达到 530 亿左右，相比上个季度大幅攀升，年化规模超 2000 亿元。我们该如何看待 AI 相关的成本投入？AI 投资带来的新增收入能在多大程度上覆盖这些投入？未来几个季度盈利会不会持续被这笔投入侵蚀？另外，如果把研发开销也算进去，这笔 AI 投资的回本周期大概是什么样的？
quotes.ko: 이번 분기 capex 530억위안을 연율화하면 2000억위안 초과 — 증분매출이 이를 얼마나 커버하는지, R&D 포함 회수기간은 얼마인지 정면 압박.

quotes.speaker: James Mitchell, Chief Strategy Officer
quotes.en: 要知道，如果我们把算力租给第三方，几乎立刻就能收回设备折旧成本，现在很多新兴云厂商都是这么操作的，我们也能在短期内拿到不错的收益。但实际上，我们有着不一样的布局，在执行一套更长远的战略。
quotes.ko: 회수기간 질문에 '외부 임대하면 감가상각은 즉시 회수 가능하지만 우리는 다른 장기 전략'이라며 숫자 없이 우회.

quotes.speaker: Martin Lau (刘炽平), President
quotes.en: 我们大手笔采购算力的核心原因，是需要算力来启动整条 AI 业务线...几个月前我们预付定金下单的一批算力设备，现在转手出售，相比当初采购价能赚超 30%。
quotes.ko: 몇 달 전 예치금 걸고 선주문한 컴퓨트 장비를 지금 되팔면 30% 이상 남는다며, GPU 선불금을 '싸게 잘 산 것'으로 정당화.

quotes.speaker: Martin Lau (刘炽平), President
quotes.en: 投向 AI 原生业务的资本开支，主要是今年和明年一次性集中投入，大家不要默认我们每年都会维持同等大额投入。模型训练属于固定成本，只需要储备足额算力即可。
quotes.ko: AI 네이티브向 capex는 올해·내년 '일회성 집중투입'이니 매년 같은 규모를 가정하지 말라 — 연율화 반박 논리.

quotes.speaker: Martin Lau (刘炽平), President — replying to Gary Yu, Morgan Stanley
quotes.en: 现阶段我们不会给出精确量化目标...投入规模会设置上限...但如果我们预判能打造出规模庞大、长期盈利的 AI 业务，也会适度加码投入。
quotes.ko: AI 포함 영업이익 성장 전환 시점을 묻자 '현 단계에서 정확한 정량 목표는 제시하지 않는다'고 명시적 거부.

quotes.speaker: James Mitchell, Chief Strategy Officer — replying to Alex Liu, BofA Merrill Lynch
quotes.en: 资本分配策略会动态调整，根据市场环境灵活变化。如果我们判断加码算力资本开支、用算力自研大模型、对外租赁算力供给WorkBuddy令牌业务、售卖模型即服务能拿到超额回报，我们就会把更多现金投向资本开支，相应缩减股票回购资金规模，整体保持动态平衡。
quotes.ko: 자사주매입 vs capex 우선순위 질문에 '초과수익 판단되면 자사주를 줄이고 capex를 늘린다'며 바이백 축소 가능성 시사.

quotes.speaker: Kenneth Fong, UBS
quotes.en: global peers have been allocating 80% to even 100% of their operating cash flow to AI CapEx, compared to Tencent which invests roughly 35% in the last quarter. However, many of these peers have experienced decline in free cash flow ROE, as their business become more asset heavy... could you share or provide more quantifiable guidance on the AI-related CapEx for the year, and what KPI are being used to assess the value creation and return on this investment
quotes.ko: 글로벌 피어는 영업현금흐름의 80~100%를 AI capex에 쓰는데 텐센트는 35%뿐 — 연간 AI capex의 '정량 가이던스'와 ROI KPI를 달라고 직접 요구.
quotes.note: Reconstructed from the search-indexed Yahoo/AlphaSpread transcript text; the transcript page itself 404s on direct fetch. Substance independently corroborated by Sina's Chinese minutes of the same call.

quotes.speaker: James Mitchell, Chief Strategy Officer
quotes.en: We should expect a substantial increase in [capital expenditure], especially in the second half of this year as more China-designed ASICs become available to us month by month through the year.
quotes.ko: 정량 가이던스 요구에 숫자 없이 '하반기 대폭 증가, 국산 ASIC 공급 확대에 연동'이라는 정성적 답변으로 대체.

quotes.speaker: James Mitchell, Chief Strategy Officer
quotes.en: If we buy GPUs and we deploy them into our ad tech, then that's a relatively short-cycle investment... There's been many products within Tencent … that went through lengthy incubation periods where they had no return on investment, but we were confident in the franchise value creation.
quotes.ko: ROI 프레임을 '광고용 GPU는 단기회수, 기반모델용은 장기'로 분리하고 '무수익 인큐베이션기'를 선례로 들며 회수기간 확약을 회피.

quotes.speaker: James Mitchell, Chief Strategy Officer
quotes.en: The reality is we've already made the choice and paid the price in that we have prioritized a multiplicity of internal services ahead of Tencent Cloud.
quotes.ko: 칩 부족 하에 클라우드(외부매출)보다 내부 서비스를 우선했고 '이미 그 대가를 치렀다'고 인정 — 공급제약이 매출을 깎았음을 시인.

quotes.speaker: Martin Lau, President
quotes.en: Therefore … smaller cloud providers no longer have certainty that they can source supply, and they need to come to the hyperscalers. You know, the hyperscalers have been operating at low margins and so, you know, when the demand picks up, then, you know, we almost sort of as an industry have no choice but to pass through higher prices.
quotes.ko: 공급 부족이 하이퍼스케일러에 가격결정력을 넘겨 '업계가 가격 전가 외 선택지가 없다'며 capex 인플레를 매출단가 상승 논리로 전환.

quotes.speaker: Martin Lau (刘炽平), President
quotes.en: 预计2026年相关投入至少实现翻倍... 2026年，公司计划进一步提升资本开支，加大灵活算力租用力度
quotes.ko: 2026년 AI 신제품 투입은 '최소 2배'라고만 하고 연간 capex 총액 숫자는 끝내 제시하지 않음(정성적 표현으로 대체).

quotes.speaker: Martin Lau, President
quotes.en: One constraint of the cloud business growth is the availability of AI chips. When AI chips are actually in short supply, we actually prioritize internal use as opposed to renting it out externally. The other way to say it, if there is not an AI chip supply constraint, our cloud revenue should be growing more.
quotes.ko: AI 칩 부족이 클라우드 성장의 제약이며 외부 임대보다 내부 사용을 우선 — 칩만 있었으면 클라우드 매출이 더 컸을 것이라 시인.

quotes.speaker: James Mitchell, Chief Strategy Officer
quotes.en: capital expenditures for 2025 will be below our previous guidance range, but the amount will be higher than in 2024
quotes.ko: 2025년 실제 capex가 기존 가이던스('매출의 low teens %') 하단을 밑돌 것이라 인정 — 사실상 가이던스 철회.
quotes.note: Rendered back into English from Chinese-language call coverage; treat wording as approximate, substance corroborated by Reuters.

0700.HK.reading: 텐센트는 '연간 capex 숫자'를 끝까지 주지 않는 패턴이 4개 분기 연속 일관됨 — 2025년엔 'low teens %' 가이던스를 공급부족으로 스스로 하향/철회했고, 2026년엔 아예 '대폭 증가·하반기 집중'이라는 정성적 표현으로만 대체했다. 2026-Q2에서 Bernstein Robin Zhu가 '530억×4=2000억 연율'을 들이대며 회수기간을 묻자, Mitchell은 '외부 임대하면 감가는 즉시 회수되지만 우리는 다르다'로 우회했고 Martin Lau는 '올해·내년 일회성 집중투입이니 매년 가정하지 말라'며 연율화 자체를 반박했다 — 전형적 회피. Gary Yu에게는 '현 단계에서 정확한 정량 목표는 제시하지 않는다'고 명시적으로 거부. FCF가 -138억위안으로 전환된 것은 GPU 선불금 탓으로 돌리며 '선불금 제외 시 +376억' 조정치를 스스로 만들어 제시했고, Lau는 그 선불 장비를 '지금 되팔면 30% 남는다'며 자산가치 상승으로 방어했다. 핵심 리스크는 바이백 축소를 명시적으로 capex 재원으로 언급하기 시작했다는 점.

9988.HK.name: Alibaba

quotes.speaker: Kenneth Fong, UBS
quotes.en: I have a question regarding the return on invested capital on the AI investment. While our AI investment have driven impressive 40% cloud growth, they have also created significant drag on the group free cash flow as well as our EBITDA. How should investor assess the return on this investment? What's the management framework for balancing the aggressive AI spending versus earnings stability?
quotes.ko: AI 투자가 클라우드 40% 성장을 만들었지만 그룹 FCF와 EBITDA를 심각하게 훼손 — 투자수익을 어떻게 평가해야 하냐고 정면 압박.

quotes.speaker: Toby Xu, CFO
quotes.en: The negative free cash flow is primarily due to the very significant investments we've been making in AI over the past year, and we've been extremely resolute in making those investments precisely because we've seen the historic opportunity of AI.
quotes.ko: 마이너스 FCF는 전적으로 AI 투자 탓이며 '역사적 기회'라 단호히 집행했다는 답 — 회수 프레임 없이 의지 표명으로 대체.

quotes.speaker: Alibaba management (transcript speaker label corrupted; SCMP attributes to CEO Eddie Wu) — replying to Gary Yu, Morgan Stanley
quotes.en: if you compare where things were in the year 2022 before this explosive growth in AI models and what we expect to need in 2033, I think we're talking about 10x increase. We need 10 times the amount of data center infrastructure compared to what we had in 2022. There are different ways to get that compute capacity. Some of it can be CapEx, part of it can also be OpEx, and we're actually now acquiring quite a bit of computing capacity using OpEx... it's likely given that kind of investment that we will overshoot the original CapEx figure that we had stated of CNY 380 billion.
quotes.ko: 3800억위안 3개년 capex 계획을 '초과할 가능성이 크다'고 인정하고, 컴퓨트 조달의 상당 부분을 OpEx로 돌리고 있다고 밝힘(진짜 투자강도는 capex 라인에 안 잡힘).
quotes.note: investing.com prints this block under an analyst label (Ellie Jiang, Macquarie) — clearly a speaker-label parsing artifact of the English interpretation channel. Content is unambiguously management.

quotes.speaker: Eddie Wu, CEO
quotes.en: I can tell you that today there isn't a single card on our servers that is idle. We see the ROI on this investment in the next three to five-year period as being extremely clear.
quotes.ko: '우리 서버엔 놀고 있는 카드가 단 한 장도 없다'며 가동률로 ROI를 대신 방어 — 정량 회수기간은 끝내 미제시.

calls.note: investing.com mislabels this article 'Q2 2025'; content confirms the Sept-2025 quarter.

quotes.speaker: Toby Xu, CFO
quotes.en: The second part of the question had to do with the incremental revenue being driven by these capital expenditures. If there's some kind of ratio that we can calculate between X amount of CapEx investment and X amount of incremental revenue, I don't think it's really possible to make that kind of estimate, at least for the time being, because overall the AI sector is still in the early phases of its development.
quotes.ko: capex 1원당 증분매출 비율을 묻자 '적어도 당분간은 그런 추정 자체가 불가능하다'며 명시적으로 산출을 거부 — 가장 날카로운 회피.

quotes.speaker: Eddie Wu, CEO
quotes.en: The RMB 380 billion figure we had mentioned previously might be on the small side, certainly in terms of the customer demand that we're currently seeing... If we're not able to satisfy all of that customer demand especially well with the current pace of investment, then we wouldn't rule out further scaling up that CapEx investment.
quotes.ko: 3800억위안조차 '작을 수 있다'며 6개월 뒤 초과 인정을 예고한 상향 시그널.

quotes.speaker: Eddie Wu, CEO
quotes.en: The pace at which we can add new servers is insufficient to keep up with the growth in customer orders... Supply is unable to keep up with demand for all of these components globally.
quotes.ko: 서버 증설 속도가 주문 증가를 못 따라가고 부품 공급이 전 세계적으로 부족 — 수요가 아니라 공급이 병목.

quotes.speaker: Toby Xu, CFO
quotes.en: Free cash flow was an outflow of RMB 21.8 billion, which reflected our significant investments in quick commerce business and AI+ cloud infrastructure.
quotes.ko: FCF -218억위안을 즉시배송과 AI·클라우드 인프라 투자로 설명.

quotes.speaker: Eddie Wu, CEO
quotes.en: Over the next three to five years, global AI compute capacity is expected to remain in short supply, with even tighter constraints in China.
quotes.ko: 향후 3~5년간 글로벌 AI 컴퓨트 공급부족 지속, 중국은 더 심각 — 구조적 공급제약 선언.

9988.HK.reading: 알리바바는 텐센트와 정반대로 '숫자를 주되 계속 상향'하는 패턴이다. 2025-11월 Eddie Wu가 3800억위안 3개년 계획을 '작을 수 있다'고 했고, 2026-05월엔 '초과할 가능성이 크다'로 확정됐다. 다만 ROI만큼은 철저히 회피 — Toby Xu는 'capex 대비 증분매출 비율은 추정 자체가 불가능하다'고 명시적으로 거부했고, Eddie Wu는 '놀고 있는 카드가 한 장도 없다'는 가동률 서사로 대체했다. FY2026 연간 FCF는 -466억위안(전년 +739억위안)으로 약 1200억위안 스윙. 가장 중요한 디테일은 '컴퓨트 조달의 상당 부분을 OpEx로 하고 있다'는 발언 — 헤드라인 capex가 실제 투자강도를 과소표시한다는 뜻이다.

9888.HK.name: Baidu

quotes.speaker: Thomas Chong, Jefferies
quotes.en: As AI investment continues to ramp up across the industry, how should we think about Baidu CapEx level in 2026? How does management prioritize capital allocation between AI investment and shareholders' return?
quotes.ko: 2026년 capex 수준을 대놓고 물으며 AI 투자와 주주환원 사이 우선순위를 요구.

quotes.speaker: Haijian (Henry) He, CFO
quotes.en: On the topic you mentioned on CapEx, our overall approach is to maintain strategic investment intensity while preserving financial discipline... From a financial standpoint, we have the capacity to support this level of investment. Thomas, as you noticed, our operating profit and operating cash flow remain healthy... Our operating cash flow for Baidu continued to be positive at CNY 2.7 billion in Q1 this quarter, the third consecutive quarter since turning positive in Q3 last year. Meanwhile, we are drawing on a mix of financing channels and the different instruments, including operating leases, financial leases, and other low-cost bank borrowings as well to fund our AI investments
quotes.ko: capex 숫자를 일절 주지 않고 '투자강도 유지+재무규율'이라는 형용사로 대체, 게다가 FCF를 빼고 영업현금흐름만 인용 — 바로 그 분기 FCF가 마이너스 전환했기 때문.

quotes.speaker: Dou Shen, EVP AI Cloud Group
quotes.en: On supply, domestic AI chips still face near-term challenges around the capacity and the supply chain maturity. Partly because demand is growing faster than supply.
quotes.ko: 국산 AI 칩의 생산능력·공급망 성숙도가 단기 과제이며 수요가 공급보다 빠르게 증가 중이라 인정.

quotes.speaker: Alex Yao, JPMorgan
quotes.en: Do you have a sufficient compute capacity to support future growth?
quotes.ko: 향후 성장을 뒷받침할 컴퓨트 용량이 충분하냐는 직설 질문 — 끝내 '예'라는 답을 못 받음.

quotes.speaker: Dou Shen, EVP AI Cloud Group
quotes.en: with demand remaining strong and supply relatively tight, we are actively expanding capacity and improving resource efficiency to better support the growing customer needs.
quotes.ko: '충분하냐'는 질문에 '수요는 강하고 공급은 타이트하다'는 답 — 사실상 부정을 우회 표현.

quotes.speaker: Ellie Jiang, Macquarie
quotes.en: How do you think about the AI-related CapEx over the next 12 to 24 months? How should we think about the return profile of these AI investments and the expected impact on the ROIC over time?
quotes.ko: 향후 12~24개월 AI capex와 그 수익 프로파일·ROIC 영향을 함께 요구.

quotes.speaker: Haijian (Henry) He, CFO
quotes.en: This is Henry. First of all, on CapEx and AI investment, since we have launched early in March of 2023, we have invested over RMB 100 billion in AI. Going forward, we will continue to maintain this level of investment density... Importantly, operating cash flow for Baidu turned positive in Q3 and remained positive in Q4... Free cash flow for Baidu also turned positive in Q4. Thirdly, we have also found and explored alternate ways of supporting our financial needs including, for example, operational and financing leasing as well as we have access to the low-cost interest banking borrowing... some of these bank borrowings and the leasing facilities carry the interest rates as low as below 2%.
quotes.ko: 미래 capex 질문에 과거 누적 '1000억위안 초과'라는 후행 숫자로 답하고 '투자밀도 유지'로 마무리 — 전향 숫자 제로. 이때만 FCF 흑자전환을 자랑했다가 다음 분기 마이너스 전환 후 언급 중단.

quotes.speaker: Wei Xiong, UBS
quotes.en: Could you please explain this quarter's asset impairment and its rational? And second, what are your CapEx plans for next year?
quotes.ko: 이번 분기 자산손상 사유와 내년 capex 계획을 함께 질문.

quotes.speaker: Haijian (Henry) He, CFO
quotes.en: Second, on the capital expenditures, we are maintaining a high level of investment. Just to give you one example. Since Baidu launched ERNIE in March of 2023, we have invested well above RMB 100 billion in the AI investment. Going forward, we will continue increasing our investment intensity in the AI area.
quotes.ko: '내년 capex 계획'을 묻는 질문에 누적 투자액만 제시하고 '투자강도 증대'로 답변 종료 — 숫자 없음.

quotes.speaker: Haijian (Henry) He, CFO
quotes.en: we are accelerating investments in the latest AI computing technologies without any hesitation. So as part of this effort, we have conducted a comprehensive review of our infrastructure portfolio. Some of the existing assets no longer meet today's computing efficiency requirements. So we actually proactively did some impairments.
quotes.ko: 기존 컴퓨트 자산 일부가 '오늘의 연산효율 요건에 미달'해 선제적으로 손상처리 — AI 서버 조기 진부화를 회사가 스스로 인정.

9888.HK.reading: 바이두는 3개 분기 연속으로 '전향적 capex 숫자'를 단 한 번도 주지 않았다. UBS·Macquarie·Jefferies 세 곳이 각각 정면으로 물었으나 답은 매번 '투자강도(intensity)/투자밀도(density) 유지'라는 형용사였고, 유일하게 제시된 숫자는 후행 누적치('2023년 3월 이래 1000억위안 초과')뿐이다. 표현은 오히려 후퇴 중 — '투자강도 증대'(25Q3) → '투자밀도 유지'(25Q4) → '투자강도 유지 + 재무규율 병행'(26Q1). 가장 중요한 텔은 26Q1이다: capex가 QoQ +199%(19.5억→58.4억위안)로 급증하고 FCF가 +6.1억에서 -33.6억위안으로 뒤집혔는데, 직전 분기에 스스로 'FCF 흑자전환'을 자랑했던 CFO가 이번엔 FCF를 한 번도 입에 올리지 않고 영업현금흐름만 인용했다 — 그리고 어떤 애널리스트도 이를 지적하지 않았다. 더불어 오퍼레이팅/파이낸스 리스와 2% 미만 은행차입을 반복 강조하는 만큼, 실제 AI 인프라 약정은 보고된 현금 capex보다 크다.

3896.HK.name: Kingsoft Cloud

quotes.speaker: Timothy Zhao, Goldman Sachs
quotes.en: And my second question is regarding your CapEx and also lease assets. I noticed that the total amount spent was around RMB 3 billion in the first quarter. Just wondering if you can provide us an update on how you think about this total CapEx number for this year?
quotes.ko: 1분기 capex+리스자산 30억위안을 근거로 연간 총액 업데이트를 요구 — 사실상 연율화 질문.

quotes.speaker: Yi Li, CFO
quotes.en: we have to admit the supply chain capacity is the primary limiting factor for the capital spending for the 2026. And we estimate that our base estimate to say for the 2026 is around RMB 15 billion to RMB 20 billion at this moment.
quotes.ko: '2026년 자본지출의 1차 제약은 수요도 자금도 아닌 공급망 캐파'라 인정하면서도 150~200억위안이라는 구체 레인지를 제시 — 4사 중 유일하게 정면 가이던스.

quotes.speaker: Yi Li, CFO
quotes.en: The increase was mainly due to the depreciation of newly acquired and leased servers and network equipment, which were mainly related to AI business.
quotes.ko: 신규 취득·리스 서버와 네트워크 장비의 감가상각이 비용 증가의 주원인 — 감가 램프 진행 중.

quotes.speaker: Tao Liu, Senior Vice President
quotes.en: the margin levels for this token business, inference business in general is higher than traditional cloud computing business.
quotes.ko: 토큰·추론 사업 마진이 전통 클라우드보다 높다며 대규모 capex를 수익성 논리로 방어.

quotes.speaker: Timothy Zhao, Goldman Sachs
quotes.en: And also on the capital expenditure plan, what is your thought and considering the balance sheet and also the prepayment from certain customers, do you think it's possible to further raise your CapEx plan given the rising AI demand?
quotes.ko: 고객 선수금과 재무구조를 감안해 capex 계획을 더 올릴 수 있냐고 질문(압박 방향이 상향).

quotes.speaker: Yi Li, CFO
quotes.en: For 2026, we expect total CapEx and control assets to exceed RMB 10 billion, representing expansion from 2025 level.
quotes.ko: 2026년 capex+리스자산 100억위안 초과 가이던스 — 불과 9주 뒤 150~200억위안으로 상향된다.

quotes.speaker: Yi Li, CFO
quotes.en: 2026 capital expenditure are secured through 4 channels. First, proceeds from our 2025 financing; and second, customer operating receipts; and third, the strategic customer prepayments; and the fourth, the commitment credit facilities from banks and financial institutions. We expect approximately half of our CapEx is targeted to be covered by customer prepayment arrangements, which will significantly reduce our funding requirements.
quotes.ko: capex 재원을 4개 채널로 명시하고 절반가량을 '전략고객 선수금'으로 커버한다고 밝힘 — 깊은 마이너스 FCF의 자금조달 구조를 이례적으로 구체 공개.

quotes.speaker: Yi Li, CFO
quotes.en: We plan to access more assets through short and long-term leases, with payment structure as operating cash flows to minimize upfront capital commitments.
quotes.ko: 리스 비중을 늘려 선지출을 최소화하고 지급을 영업현금흐름으로 돌리겠다 — 헤드라인 capex가 실제 캐파 지출을 과소표시하게 되는 구조.

quotes.speaker: Tao Zou, Vice Chairman & Acting CEO
quotes.en: Premium customers, for example, like Xiaomi. We would tend to choose the CapEx model. While in other growth stage companies, medium and small-sized companies, we generally tend to adopt the leasing model.
quotes.ko: 샤오미 같은 우량 고객엔 자체 capex, 성장기·중소 고객엔 리스 모델 — 고객 신용도에 따라 자본 리스크를 분리.

3896.HK.reading: 킹소프트클라우드는 4사 중 유일하게 capex를 회피 없이 정면으로 숫자로 가이던스했고, 그 숫자가 9주 만에 '100억위안 초과'(26/3/25)에서 '150~200억위안'(26/5/27)으로 50~100% 상향됐다 — 중국 AI capex 사이클의 가장 민감한 고베타 지표. 결정적으로 CFO가 밝힌 병목은 수요도 자금도 아닌 '공급망 캐파'다. 자금조달은 4개 채널(2025년 조달금·영업수취·전략고객 선수금·은행 약정한도)로 공개했고 capex의 약 절반을 고객 선수금으로 커버한다 — 즉 마이너스 FCF가 고객 선불에 구조적으로 의존한다. 다만 'capex'가 일관되게 capex+리스자산 합산으로 제시되고 리스 비중을 의도적으로 늘리는 중이라, 헤드라인 capex는 실제 캐파 지출을 과소표시한다. 특이점: 3개 분기 어느 콜에서도 애널리스트가 회수기간·ROI를 한 번도 묻지 않았다.

Obviously, from what Clay has gone through, the most interesting thing that you should start thinking about is the uncoupling of CapEx with capital requirements from Oracle Corporation.
quotes.ko: FY27 capex 답변을 다음 분기로 미루면서 'capex와 오라클 본사 자본소요의 분리'라는 프레임으로 전환

quotes.speaker: Clay Magouyrk, co-CEO
quotes.en: On our last earnings call, I shared multiple ideas for how we can incrementally grow our AI infrastructure without Oracle Corporation raising more debt or issuing equity. We have signed more than $29 billion of contracts since then, across multiple customers using that new model.
quotes.ko: 추가 차입·증자 없이 AI 인프라를 늘리는 신모델로 290억달러 이상 계약 체결했다고 주장

quotes.speaker: Doug Kehring, Principal Financial Officer
quotes.en: Operating cash flow in Q2 was $2.1 billion, while free cash flow was a negative $10 billion and CapEx was $12 billion reflecting the investments being made to support our accelerating growth.
quotes.ko: 영업현금 21억달러 대비 capex 120억달러로 FCF -100억달러, 성장투자 때문이라고 설명

quotes.speaker: Brad Zelnick, Deutsche Bank
quotes.en: Very specifically, how much money does Oracle need to raise to fund its AI growth plans ahead?
quotes.ko: AI 증설 자금을 정확히 얼마나 조달해야 하냐고 콕 집어 질문
quotes.evaded_why: 먼저 '정확히 답하기 어려운 이유'부터 설명하고, 끝내 금액 대신 '시장 추정 1000억달러보다 훨씬 적을 것'이라고만 답

quotes.speaker: Clay Magouyrk, co-CEO
quotes.en: So look. I'll answer that question in two parts. First, let me give you kind of the reason why it's hard to answer that question exactly.
quotes.ko: 조달 금액 질문에 '정확히 답하기 어려운 이유'부터 설명하며 구체 수치 회피

quotes.speaker: Doug Kehring, Principal Financial Officer
quotes.en: In addition, there are other financing options through customers that may bring their own chips to be installed in our data centers and suppliers who may lease their chips rather than sell them. Both of these options enable Oracle to synchronize our payments with our receipts and borrow substantially less than most people are modeling.
quotes.ko: 고객 자체칩 반입·벤더 칩 리스로 시장 모델보다 차입을 훨씬 줄일 수 있다는 부외조달 구조 설명

ORCL.reading: FY26Q2 FCF -100억달러(capex 120억)에서 FY26 연간 순현금 capex 480억달러, FY27 700억달러(선수금 200~250억 제외한 수치라 보고 capex는 900억달러대)로 적자가 아니라 규모 자체가 계단식 확대. 조달은 Q3에 500억달러 한도 중 300억달러(투자등급 본드+의무전환우선주)를 즉시 소화했고 FY27에 400억달러(ATM 주식 200억 포함) 추가 예정 - 투자등급 유지가 사실상 유일한 방어선. 회피 패턴이 뚜렷: Q3에서 FY27 capex 가시성 질문을 '회계연도 끝나고 얘기하자'로 완전 차단한 뒤 Q4에야 숫자를 열었고, 신임 CFO의 ROIC '20% 후반'도 GPU 재투자(내용연수) 가정을 명시적으로 뺀 수치다. 리스크의 핵심은 BYOH·고객선수금·벤더 칩리스로 오라클 본사 대차대조표에서 capex를 '디커플링'하는 구조인데, RPO 6380억달러의 12%만 12개월 내 인식되므로 현금유입은 뒤에 있고 현금유출은 앞에 있다.

AMZN.name: Amazon

quotes.speaker: Andy Jassy, CEO
quotes.en: We now believe we will spend approximately $220 billion in cash CapEx in 2026. The higher cost of memory pushing this number up from our prior estimate of about $200 billion. Even at that amount, we will still not have enough capacity to meet all the demand we have in 2026, and I believe this dynamic will also be true in 2027, too.
quotes.ko: 2026년 캐펙스를 2,000억→2,200억 달러로 상향(메모리 가격), 그럼에도 수요를 다 못 받는다며 2027년까지 공급부족 지속 예고.

quotes.speaker: Andy Jassy, CEO
quotes.en: For servers and networking equipment, on average, it takes a little less than three years to break even on that investment. The servers currently have a useful life of at least five to six years, and most of our AI capacity these days is being contracted for at least five-year terms.
quotes.ko: 서버·네트워크 장비는 3년 미만에 손익분기, 내용연수 5~6년, AI 물량은 최소 5년 계약이라며 감가·회수기간을 선제 방어.

quotes.speaker: Andy Jassy, CEO
quotes.en: This means in the short term, when demand is necessitating so many data centers being built simultaneously in advance of when we can start monetizing them, we'll spend a lot of CapEx and encounter free cash flow headwinds until these data centers come online, can be monetized, and we get a few years into these servers being utilized.
quotes.ko: 데이터센터를 수익화 이전에 동시다발로 짓는 구조라 가동·수익화 전까지 FCF 역풍이 불가피하다고 사전 인정.

quotes.speaker: Colin Sebastian, Baird
quotes.en: Brian, just given the demand signals you guys are both talking about and plans for additional capacity, what are your current thoughts on sources of capital for the build-out over the next couple of years?
quotes.ko: 향후 2년 증설 자금을 어디서 조달할 것이냐고 CFO를 직접 지목해 질문.
quotes.evaded_why: CFO에게 물었으나 CEO 제이시가 가로채 답변, 회사채 발행 사실만 인정하고 조달구조는 '오늘 공유할 것 없다'로 종결

quotes.speaker: Andy Jassy, CEO
quotes.en: You've seen us issue debt this year. We have a lot of options available to us as we continue to fund this growth that we're seeing in AWS. We'll continue to look at all the options and make the appropriate decision at the right time, but nothing to share today.
quotes.ko: 올해 회사채 발행 사실만 인정하고, 향후 조달수단(부채·리스·구조화)은 '오늘 공유할 것 없다'며 함구.

quotes.speaker: Andrew R. Jassy, CEO
quotes.en: However, these CapEx investments fund assets with many-year useful lives—30-plus years for data centers, five to six years for chips, servers, and networking gear. The free cash flow and ROIC for these investments are cumulatively quite attractive a couple of years after being in service. However, in times of very high growth like now, where the CapEx growth meaningfully outpaces the revenue growth, the early years’ free cash flow is challenged until these initial tranches of capacity are being monetized and revenue growth outpaces CapEx growth.
quotes.ko: 내용연수(DC 30년+, 칩·서버 5~6년)를 근거로 장기 ROIC를 방어하면서, 캐펙스 증가율이 매출 증가율을 앞지르는 지금 국면에선 '초기 연도 FCF가 훼손된다'고 명시 인정.

quotes.speaker: Shweta Khajuria, Wolfe Research
quotes.en: I wonder, Andy, if you could please talk about how you are thinking about the increase in price for memory and storage and just the supply chain inflation we are seeing and the impact it could have on CapEx this year and potentially next year as well.
quotes.ko: 메모리·스토리지 가격 급등이 올해와 내년 캐펙스에 미칠 영향을 수치로 달라고 압박.
quotes.evaded_why: 캐펙스 영향은 수치·방향 모두 미제시, '용량 제약은 없다'로 마무리했으나 한 분기 뒤 메모리 때문에 캐펙스를 200억 달러 상향

quotes.speaker: Mark Mahaney, Evercore ISI
quotes.en: So could you give us a little bit more insight into how you think investors will be able to see that? Either, talk about the duration of the CapEx cycle that you're going through now or, what we should see in terms of profitability levels? And maybe also talk about, like, other de minimis or minimum free cash flow generation levels that you don't want to go below as you go through this CapEx cycle?
quotes.ko: 캐펙스 사이클의 '기간'과, 이 사이클 동안 밑돌지 않으려는 '최소 FCF 수준'을 콕 집어 요구.
quotes.evaded_why: 캐펙스 사이클 기간도, FCF 하한선도 답하지 않고 AWS 영업이익률 35%와 'ROIC 강할 것'이라는 확신 표명으로 대체

quotes.speaker: Andrew Jassy, CEO
quotes.en: Operating income was $25 billion, and trailing twelve-month free cash flow was $11.2 billion.
quotes.ko: 2025년 영업현금흐름 1,395억 달러에도 TTM FCF는 112억 달러까지 압축됐음을 오프닝에서 공개.

AMZN.reading:
캐펙스 궤적: 2월 콜 '2026년 약 2,000억 달러' → Q1 실제 432억 → Q2 실제 531억, 7월 콜에서 연 2,200억으로 상향(메모리 인플레). 2027년에도 '수요 대비 용량 부족'이라 못박아 감속 신호는 전무.
FCF: 2025년 영업현금흐름 1,395억 달러인데 TTM FCF는 112억 달러로 사실상 소멸. 경영진은 '초기 연도 FCF 훼손'·'FCF 역풍'을 선제 인정하며 구조적 마이너스 FCF 국면 진입을 사실상 예고.
회계·조달이 핵심 리스크: 서버 내용연수 5~6년·DC 30년+를 근거로 3년 미만 손익분기를 주장하고 '내용연수 연장 트랙레코드'까지 강조 — 감가상각 이연 여지 상존. 자금조달 질문(Sebastian)에는 회사채 발행만 인정하고 '오늘 공유할 것 없다'며 회피, 부채·리스 구조가 최대 미공개 변수.
애널리스트 압박 3연타(Mahaney의 FCF 하한선, Khajuria의 메모리→캐펙스 영향, Sebastian의 조달원)에 모두 수치 미제시 — 특히 Khajuria 회피는 한 분기 뒤 200억 달러 상향으로 사후 반증됨.

CRWV.name: CoreWeave

quotes.speaker: Nitin Agrawal, CFO
quotes.en: As a result of our increased expectations around capacity to be delivered to customers this year, as well as some of our significant recent wins, we now expect 2026 CapEx in the range of $35 billion- $39 billion. Finally, we are also raising our expected end of year annualized run rate revenue to $18.5 billion- $19.5 billion.
quotes.ko: 2026 CAPEX를 $35–39B로 상향(직전 $31–35B), 연말 연율매출 목표도 $18.5–19.5B로 상향.

quotes.speaker: Nitin Agrawal, CFO
quotes.en: We expect CapEx to be $11.5 billion- $13.5 billion based on the significant amount of new capacity we will be delivering to customers.
quotes.ko: 3분기 단독 CAPEX $11.5–13.5B — 인도할 신규 capacity가 크다.

quotes.speaker: Michael Intrator, CEO
quotes.en: But those economics do not arrive evenly. The cost, primarily in the form of CapEx, is front-loaded, requiring a combination of debt, customer prepayments, and other corporate-level capital to finance its build-out. Once the cluster is delivered, contracted revenue ramps, becoming predictable and highly cash flow generative.
quotes.ko: CAPEX가 매출·현금흐름에 선행(front-loaded)하며 부채·고객선수금·본사자본으로 조달. 클러스터 인도 후에야 계약매출이 램프.

quotes.speaker: 애널리스트
quotes.en: I guess off the back of DDTL 5.5, where you were able to get funding for shorter duration contracts... How does the success of DDTL 5.5 change the way you view on target durations on a go-forward basis? Is that an avenue you want to use more to maybe extract more margin in shorter duration contracts, given you know the useful life is there?
quotes.ko: DDTL 5.5(단기계약 조달) 성공이 목표 계약기간을 바꾸나 — 짧은 계약으로 마진을 더 뽑을 셈인가?

quotes.speaker: Nitin Agrawal, CFO
quotes.en: For the full year, we now expect CapEx of $31 billion to $35 billion. The increase on the low end from our previous guidance is related to increases in component pricing.
quotes.ko: 연간 CAPEX $31–35B로 상향, 하단 인상은 부품가격 상승 때문.

quotes.speaker: Nitin Agrawal, CFO
quotes.en: And Keith, to round up your answer on the CapEx piece. CapEx shows for us before revenue and cash flow. So you see showing up first. The piece on the P&L impact of that is already incorporated in the guidance that we've issued you today.
quotes.ko: CAPEX는 매출·현금흐름보다 먼저 계상된다 — 시차 구조를 강조.

quotes.speaker: 애널리스트
quotes.en: And maybe starting on the CapEx side of the equation and the higher component pricing. I think that's something that's weighing on the stock a little bit after hours. Can you explain to us how the higher component pricing works through the contract and how that ultimately affects your profitability?
quotes.ko: 부품가 상승이 주가를 누르는데, 계약·수익성에 어떻게 전가되나?

quotes.speaker: Nitin Agrawal, CFO
quotes.en: We expect 2026 CapEx of $30 billion to $35 billion, which is more than double our 2025 investment. Substantially all of it is tied to our already signed customer contracts that we intend to bring online this year as we expect to double our active power capacity to more than 1.7 gigawatts by year-end.
quotes.ko: 2026 CAPEX $30–35B, 2025의 2배 이상 — 대부분 이미 체결된 고객계약 연동, 연말 가동전력 1.7GW+로 2배.

quotes.speaker: 애널리스트
quotes.en: One of the things going on in the industry is there is all this CapEx and not enough margin or cash flow necessarily in the near term... What is your confidence in the rate of the CapEx growth?
quotes.ko: 업계 전반이 CAPEX만 크고 근시일 마진·현금흐름이 부족한데, CAPEX 성장속도에 대한 확신은?

CRWV.reading: 순수 AI 클라우드로 CAPEX가 매출·현금흐름에 구조적으로 선행(front-loaded). 2026 가이던스를 $30–35B→$31–35B→$35–39B로 연중 두 번 상향하면서도 "대부분 이미 체결된 고객계약 연동"이라며 방어. FCF는 지속 마이너스이고 부채·파이낸스리스·고객선수금(누계 $32B+)으로 조달 — 급증하는 감가상각·이자비용이 핵심 리스크. 애널리스트는 반복적으로 "CAPEX만 크고 현금흐름이 없다"고 압박.

calls.note: Q2 인용은 investing.com 트랜스크립트에서 추출, stockanalysis.com 및 official blog.google(Pichai 발언)과 수치·문구 교차검증. roic.ai/benzinga/seekingalpha는 403 차단.

quotes.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, CFO
quotes.en: We are updating our full-year 2026 CapEx guidance range to $195 billion-$205 billion, up from our previous estimate of $180 billion-$190 billion.
quotes.ko: 2026년 연간 capex 가이던스를 기존 $180~190B에서 $195~205B로 상향. 불과 한 분기 전(Q1)에도 $175~185B→$180~190B로 올린 데 이어 재상향.

quotes.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO
quotes.en: We continue to be supply constrained, a sign of momentum and rapid adoption.
quotes.ko: 여전히 공급 제약 상태이며, 이를 수요 모멘텀·빠른 채택의 방증이라고 포장. (blog.google 공식 CEO 발언에서도 동일 확인)

quotes.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, CFO
quotes.en: We had negative free cash flow of $5.9 billion in the second quarter, driven by our investments in CapEx. We expect the free cash flow will remain under pressure, driven by our investments in technical infrastructure.
quotes.ko: Q2 잉여현금흐름이 -$59억으로 사상 첫 적자 전환(Q1 +$101억에서 급반전). CFO는 기술 인프라 투자로 FCF가 계속 압박받을 것이라고 명시적으로 인정.

quotes.speaker: Brian Nowak, Morgan Stanley (analyst)
quotes.en: Can you just give us some perspective on how your view on the size of the overall GenAI ROIC opportunity ... How is your budgeting philosophy and just constraints you're putting onto forward spend?
quotes.ko: GenAI ROIC 기회의 규모와 '향후 지출에 두는 제약(상한)'을 콕 집어 압박. 이에 Ashkenazi는 "매력적 수익이 보이는 한 계속 투자하겠다(As long as we see these attractive opportunity to invest, we will continue to invest)"며 상한을 제시하지 않는 개방형 답변, Pichai는 "기회에 더 낙관적"이라고 응수 — 정면 회피는 아니나 지출 상한은 끝내 제시하지 않음.

quotes.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, CFO
quotes.en: We are updating our full year 2026 CapEx guidance range to $180 billion to $190 billion, up from our previous estimate of $175 billion to $185 billion to now include investment related to the acquisition of Intersect, which closed in March.
quotes.ko: Q1 시점 2026 capex 가이던스는 $180~190B(직전 $175~185B에서 상향). 같은 콜에서 "2027 capex는 2026 대비 크게 증가할 것"이라 예고. 당시 FCF는 아직 +$101억 흑자였으나 3개월 뒤 Q2엔 $195~205B로 재상향+FCF 적자 전환 — 상향·소진의 궤적을 보여주는 앵커.

GOOGL.reading: 알파벳은 2026 capex 가이던스를 반년 새 $180~190B→$195~205B로 재상향했고, Q2 FCF가 사상 처음 -$59억으로 적자 전환(Q1 +$101억에서 급반전). Pichai는 '공급 제약'을 성장의 방증으로 포장하지만, CFO는 감가상각·데이터센터 운영비가 P&L을 계속 압박한다고 인정. Nowak의 ROIC·지출 상한 질문엔 '매력적 수익이 보이는 한 무제한 투자'라는 개방형 답변으로 상한 제시를 사실상 거부 — capex 급증이 당분간 FCF를 계속 갉아먹는 구조가 고착.

quotes.speaker: Susan Li, CFO
quotes.en: We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $130-145 billion, narrowed from our prior outlook of $125-145 billion.
quotes.ko: 2026 capex를 $130~145B로 제시(하단을 $125B→$130B로 올려 상향). Q2 단일 분기 capex는 $31.1B(서버·데이터센터·네트워크).

quotes.speaker: Susan Li, CFO
quotes.en: Free cash flow was $784 million. We ended the quarter with $90.3 billion in cash and marketable securities and $83.7 billion in debt.

quotes.speaker: Brian Nowak, Morgan Stanley (analyst)
quotes.en: There's been some public comments about capacity in '27 and doubling capacity and appreciate your color about CapEx. Any early comments on '27 CapEx, even the philosophy around sources of upside or sources of downward pressure, as you sort of think through different ways to finance this multi-year build and have '27 CapEx?

quotes.speaker: Susan Li, CFO
quotes.en: Brian, on your second question, we aren't providing a specific outlook for 2027 CapEx at this time. Infrastructure planning remains highly dynamic and even this year, there are a range of outcomes embedded in our outlook.
quotes.ko: 2027 capex 구체 전망 제시를 명시적으로 거부('지금은 제공하지 않는다'). 대신 '단기(near term) capacity가 장기보다 더 가치 있다'는 방향성만 언급하며 회피 — 초대형 선제 투자는 밀어붙이되 수치·회수는 불투명하게 남김.

quotes.speaker: Susan Li, CFO
quotes.en: We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $125-145 billion, increased from our prior range of $115-135 billion.
quotes.ko: Q1(4월) 시점 2026 capex 가이던스를 $115~135B→$125~145B로 상향(이후 Q2엔 하단을 다시 올려 $130~145B). Q1 분기 capex는 $19.8B, FCF는 아직 +$12.4억달러 흑자 — 한 분기 뒤 Q2엔 capex $31.1B·FCF $7.84억으로 급반전하는 소진 궤적의 출발점.

META.reading: 메타는 2026 capex 가이던스를 분기마다 상향($115~135B→Q1 $125~145B→Q2 $130~145B), Q2 capex $31.1B에 FCF는 $12.4억달러(Q1)에서 $7.84억으로 사실상 소진 직전 — 감가상각·데이터센터 비용이 현금흐름을 정면으로 압박. Zuckerberg는 '수요를 맞추기 위해 공격적으로 투자한다'며 선제(front-load) 기조를 고수하지만, Nowak의 2027 capex 질문에 Susan Li는 '지금은 구체 전망을 내지 않는다'며 회피하고 '단기 capacity가 장기보다 가치 있다'는 방향성만 제시. 즉 공격적 선제 투자 대비 수치·회수 가시성은 3사 중 가장 낮음.

calls.note: 회계연도 6월 종료 → FY2026 4분기 = 캘린더 2026-Q2. 트랜스크립트 내 콜 일자는 2026-07-29(fool.com URL 슬러그는 08/07이나 실제 콜은 7/29). fool.com 원문 HTML을 curl로 받아 축자 확인.

quotes.speaker: Amy Hood, CFO
quotes.en: We expect FY '27 capital expenditures will grow year-over-year given demand signals across our portfolio. Even as we invest to meet growing demand, full fiscal year operating margins should be down less than 1 point.
quotes.ko: FY27 capex가 전년비 '증가'할 것이라 예고(수요 신호 근거). 4분기 capex는 $41B(약 2/3가 리드타임 짧은 단기자산=GPU·CPU), 리스 재분류 반영 후 캘린더 2026 capex는 약 $175B. 즉 감가상각을 앞당기는 GPU 비중이 크다는 점을 명시.

quotes.speaker: Amy Hood, CFO
quotes.en: Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.
quotes.ko: Azure가 +43% 성장했음에도 '수요가 가용 capacity를 계속 초과'. Q&A에서도 "시스템에 여전히 제약이 있고 수요가 가용 공급을 계속 초과한다"고 재확인 — 수분기째 반복되는 공급제약 메시지.

quotes.speaker: Amy Hood, CFO
quotes.en: Cash flow from operations was $55.4 billion, up 30%, driven by strong cloud billings and collections, partially offset by an increase in operating lease payments. And free cash flow was $19.6 billion, reflecting higher capital expenditures.
quotes.ko: 영업현금흐름은 +30%($55.4B)로 견조하나 capex 급증으로 FCF는 $19.6B로 눌림. 별도로 'FY27에도 FCF 흑자를 유지하겠다'고 강조 — 흑자 방어를 굳이 언급해야 할 만큼 capex 부담이 커졌음을 방증.

quotes.speaker: Mark Moerdler, Bernstein Research (analyst)
quotes.en: How does Microsoft protect itself if there really is overcapacity and overbuilding of data centers or overbuilding of chips, et cetera? And on the flip side of that, how do you manage through the hardware price increases that we're seeing, the component prices and that it doesn't just drive you to either massively drive up the price of your offerings or negatively impact your margins?
quotes.ko: 과잉공급(데이터센터·칩 과잉건설)·부품가 상승 리스크를 정면으로 압박. Amy는 회피 없이 정면 답변 — capex의 상당분이 리드타임 짧은 단기자산(GPU/CPU)이라 '수요 환경이 바뀌면 가장 큰 비중을 그냥 늦추면 된다'며 유연성을 근거로 반박.

quotes.speaker: Amy Hood, CFO
quotes.en: We expect to invest roughly $190 billion in capital expenditures, which includes approximately $25 billion from the impact of higher component pricing. We remain confident in the return on these investments given higher demand signals and increasing product usage, as well as the efficiencies we are already driving across the platform. Even with these additional investments and continued efforts to bring GPU, CPU, and storage capacity online faster, we expect to remain constrained at least through 2026.
quotes.ko: Q3(4월) 시점 캘린더 2026 capex 가이던스는 약 $190B(부품가 상승분 $25B 포함), 그리고 "적어도 2026년 내내 공급 제약이 지속될 것"이라 명시 — 수분기째 반복되는 공급제약 메시지. (이후 Q4엔 리스 재분류 회계변경으로 표기상 약 $175B로 조정됐을 뿐 실제 투자 축소가 아님; 분기 capex는 $31.9B→$41B로 증가.)
